title: Canadian Syncope Risk Score
sources: Thiruganasambandamoorthy V et al. CMAJ 2016; JAMA Intern Med 2020 (validation)
purpose: 30-day risk of a serious adverse event after an ED visit for syncope (once the initial workup is negative). Applies to adults ≥ 16 y with syncope and no serious condition already identified. Do NOT apply if the cause is already established or a serious outcome is already present.

items.label: Predisposition to vasovagal symptoms (triggered by warm/crowded place, prolonged standing, fear/emotion/pain)
History of heart disease (CAD, atrial fibrillation/flutter, CHF, valvular disease)
Any systolic BP reading < 90 or > 180 mmHg in the ED
ED diagnosis of the syncope cause

interpretation.label: Medium risk — ~ 8.1% (score 1) rising to ~ 12–20%
interpretation.disposition: 15-day outpatient cardiac monitoring; shared decision on brief admission

notes: Serious adverse events tracked: death, arrhythmia, MI, structural heart disease, aortic dissection, PE, severe haemorrhage, subarachnoid haemorrhage, and any procedural intervention for the cause. The score does not replace judgement for a clearly high-risk presentation.
buildNote: Score range −3 to +11. The ED-diagnosis item is mutually exclusive (a select input).
